controls.story_publish: Durable retry-safe publish intents with seven-day TTL, hash-only persistence and exact result binding.
controls.story_archive_highlights: Owner/profile-bound archive and highlight records; Privacy Matrix is reapplied to every highlighted-media read.
controls.draft_quota: Twenty drafts and 100 MB per profile with deterministic eviction and localized quota state.
controls.upload_quota: Atomic 100 MB and twenty active-session quota; cancellation restores capacity and orphan cleanup is dry-run by default.
controls.media_delivery: Exact hash, MIME, extension, purpose and scan checks; E2EE ciphertext is forced to an opaque attachment.
controls.inbox_pagination_search: Signed HMAC cursor pagination and server search restricted to authorized local plaintext conversations.
controls.e2ee_attachment_lifecycle: Abortable decrypt, stale-context denial, object-URL revocation and safe navigation reset.
controls.call_leases: Twenty-five-second exact-participant leases with persona-bound heartbeat and local-media shutdown after heartbeat loss.
controls.group_concurrency: Optimistic title/key-epoch checks and transactional member changes prevent stale group administration.
controls.notification_realtime: Recipient/profile-bound invalidations, exact unread counters, dedupe identifiers and no events for no-op mutations.
controls.accessibility: Explicit Escape close targets, focus-visible and forced-color states, reduced motion and corrected landmark structure.

findings_resolved.problem: Synthetic actors could attempt engagement against private content without the paid entitlement required by the Privacy Matrix.
findings_resolved.resolution: The local actor lab never forges settlement; private-content interactions use the owner path while entitlement cases remain in the dedicated privacy suite.

findings_resolved.problem: Navigation could leave decrypted attachment URLs and pending decryption alive in a newer messaging context.
findings_resolved.resolution: Abort signals, context generations and deterministic URL revocation now close every stale decryption path.

findings_resolved.problem: Account-deletion security notices bypassed realtime invalidation and already-read mutations emitted phantom changes.
findings_resolved.resolution: Account lifecycle notifications use the common invalidation adapter and no-op reads return a null change identifier without publishing.

findings_resolved.problem: Group title and membership changes could overwrite a concurrent administrative decision.
findings_resolved.resolution: Expected title and key epoch are validated transactionally before any group mutation.
